topics.title: Drill Through
topics.shortDescription: Enable report users to transition from summary visuals to dedicated deep-dive detail pages.
topics.detailedDescription: Drill Through is a core contextual navigation mechanism in Power BI Desktop and Service. It lets consumers right-click a data point (such as a customer, product, or sales region) and drill into a focused destination page filtered specifically for that entity. In this module, explore destination page configuration, parameter passing, back button behavior, and cross-report drill through.
